title: erioneuron pilosum
intro: Erioneuron pilosum, commonly known as Woolly Needlegrass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, sore throats, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Erioneuron pilosum include relieving coughs, reducing fever, and soothing irritated tissues, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils. However, more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness and safety as a medicinal plant.
